When using rt_mutex
column2: a NULL pointer dereference is occurred at

column1: enqueue_task_rt. Here is a scenario;
1) there are two threads
column2: the thread A is fair_sched_class and

column1: thread B is rt_sched_class.
2) Thread A is boosted up to rt_sched_class
has a rt_mutex lock and the thread B is waiting the lock.
3) At this time
column2: when thread A create a new thread C

column1: C has a rt_sched_class.
4) When doing wake_up_new_task() for the thread C
of the thread C is out of the RT priority range
normal priority of thread A is not the RT priority. It makes
data corruption by overflowing the rt_prio_array.
The new thread C should be fair_sched_class.
The new thread should be valid scheduler class before queuing.
This patch fixes to set the suitable scheduler class.
